favorites.manage_help: The teams and leagues you select will appear at the top of your calendar and their automatic alerts will be enabled.

auth.login_subtitle: Sync your favorites across devices and enable live alerts.
auth.link_sent_body: Check your inbox and tap the link to sign in. It expires in 15 minutes.
auth.privacy: We will never post anything on your behalf or share your data. We only use your email to save your leagues and send you the alerts you choose.
auth.expired: Oops, that link has expired. No worries — enter your email again and we will send you a fresh one right away.
auth.welcome_body: All of rink hockey in one place: your teams, your leagues, and every goal the moment it happens. Pick who you follow — we'll handle the rest.
auth.upsell_body: Create a free account in 5 seconds to sync your teams across devices and get live notifications.
auth.google_failed: Google sign-in could not be completed. Try again or use the email link.
auth.account_disabled: This account is disabled. If you think this is a mistake, contact us.
auth.google_unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Sign in with your email and you'll get the same account.
auth.google_state: The Google connection expired for security reasons. Please try again.
auth.google_email: Your Google account doesn't expose a verified email. Sign in with that same email and it will be the same account.
auth.google_denied: You cancelled the Google sign-in. You can try again or sign in with your email.
auth.link_hint: If you already signed up with this email, no worries: we use the same email to identify you, so you'll land in your usual account.
auth.error_invalid_email: That email doesn't look valid. Check it and try again.
auth.error_email_unavailable: We can't send the link right now. Try again in a few minutes.

match_detail.partial_acta: The official match report is incomplete: the recorded goals do not add up to the final score.
match_detail.report_pending_body: The detailed digital report for this match is pending synchronisation. The overall score is official and final.
match_detail.lineup_unavailable: Lineup not available for this match.
match_detail.stats_pending: Stats will appear once the match starts

install.title: Goals, the moment they happen
install.body_android: Install Stick Live: open live matches in one tap and get an alert for every goal your teams score. Free, no app store needed.
install.body_ios: Add Stick Live to your home screen: open live matches in one tap and, on iPhone, it's the only way to get an alert for every goal.
install.ios_step1: Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.ios_step2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.
